## sub_4B7DE0_004b7de0 — SaveHotlapData

**Summary:** Saves hotlap (qualifying lap) telemetry/replay data to a .HOT file on disk. Part of session/telemetry persistence system.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |

| 00423a00 | BinarySearchInStringTable | checks if message buffer contains expected hotlap string |
| 004a0e70 | SessionTypeGuard | validates current session type permits hotlap recording |

| 004b7c80 | NetworkBufferRead | reads network/buffer data to include in hotlap save |

**Guard conditions:** If lap-timer float (v14 from PlayerVehiclePtr+0x409C) equals -1.0f or <= 0.0f, the entire save is skipped — blocks when no valid lap time exists. If sub_566940 file-open fails, skips VehicleForceAerodynamicsComputation/NetworkBufferRead and returns 0.
